description: The recent changes made to a domain: titles, descriptions, internal links and schema, newest first, up to 40. Each title and description change carries the page URL and its urlHash, and each schema change its changeId, which undo_change takes. With kind title, lists title changes only. Changes nothing. Needs a token; a read-only API key is sufficient and recommended.

domain.description: The connected domain, as a hostname, e.g. example.com.

kind.description: title lists title changes only. Defaults to all.

name: list_meta_changes
title: List meta changes
